source.title: Scarlet Research
source.description:
A page of the ledger catches your eye:

"Artifact - recovered near Sorrow Hill Crypt. Strong attunement to Light. Poor candidate for LW project due to warding properties and resistance to amplification enchantments. Delivered to Tyr's Hand for further study."
source.objective: Search for the artifact within the Scarlet Crusade stronghold at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.
source.completion: Opening the locker, you find a small box. Is this what you were looking for?
